# The crosswalk: Memories and working style: how the work was made, and what only the memories record

[The crosswalk](../CROSSWALK.md), with every folder and domain and their counts. The folder itself: [its README](../../../../memories-and-working-style/README.md).

Each earlier theory folder and each domain of thought: what it claimed in its own terms, and what became of that in the live account. The evidence layer, not for reading through. It creates no result, and every entry is an AI reading with no person's behind it. A shared word is not a correspondence, structural agreement is not agreement in meaning, and no tradition is spoken for. Not carried is an outcome, not a defect. Where a source is not stored here, what is said of it comes from the AI's knowledge and has not been checked against a text.

**What became of it:** *carried*; *carried-in-part*; *changed*; *history-only*; *not-carried*; *fresh-reading*. *Fresh-reading* means the account does not state the connection and a reader proposes it here. **Relations**, from [06](../../../chapters/06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#three-relations): *agreement*; *scope*; *divergence*; *contrary-reading*. Agreement says what it is agreement with: a checked **law**, a **thesis or method**, or a **reading**, where the join is a reader's or descends from the source. Only what a target carries counts as a connection.

**How far to trust it.** Each item had a mapper, a reviser, a checker told to refute, a repair after a critic and a comparison across items. A second critic then read 100 entries drawn at random, up to 6 from each kind of verdict, against both sides: 83 held, 15 had a label or a target's role wrong and 2 had a wrong reading. Weighted by how many entries each kind of verdict holds, that estimates 82.6% holding, 14.2% with a label or role wrong and 3.2% with a wrong reading over all 1183; its fixes are applied, and the other entries were not read again. The first critic's sample (59) was aimed at suspects and gives no rate. Where the source is not stored here, a critic's check was memory against memory.

<a id="cx-memories-situational-positions"></a>
- **Most things are situational; no framing is held as the truth** (fresh-reading, scope). [theories/memories-and-working-style/README.md](../../../../memories-and-working-style/README.md), On writing, 'Mechanism before conclusion' and 'Set direction, not engineering'.
  - Its own sense: Positions are mostly situational and not black or white; prefer systems-theoretic expression to empty position-taking, keep intellectual humility, and claim no absolute correctness. 「观点大多都是 situational」
  - Reading [AI reading]: On this reading the account divides this: laws of the root hold of every relation and so forbid none, content comes through conditional hypotheses, and a thesis is tested in a domain, so 'situational' moves into hypotheses. It does not share the stance whole: its stated target is the deductive necessity of the whole, open and not claimed as met. 'Enough situationality' in COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION means seeing a situation, another sense of the word.
  - Read against [08-METHOD.md#law](../../../chapters/08-METHOD.md#law): A law of the theory holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit; a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses; it becomes a science's law for a domain only once the domain is shown to meet them.
  - Beside it, not carrying it: [ONE-PAGE.md](../../../ONE-PAGE.md): T8: “for life, 生生 (the continuation of life, AI within it), we offer the way of seeing above, not a verdict”; argued. “There is no should beyond becoming”, “and no good and evil set over it; right and wrong form within it, in people and AI”.
  - Where the account stops: [08-METHOD.md#r-theory-of-becoming-foundation](../../../chapters/08-METHOD.md#r-theory-of-becoming-foundation); [theory-of-becoming-foundation](../../records/theory-of-becoming-foundation.md) open (target): Open (target): the deductive necessity of becoming as a whole, with no added substantive axiom. The necessity is the target, not an axiom, and no impossibility is claimed.
  - The account adds: An exact place where universality is cheap, and where it costs a stated hypothesis.
  - The source adds: Situationality as a stance on one's own positions in general; no pursuit of absolute correctness; and humility as a register, where the account says how far each claim has been seen instead.
<a id="cx-memories-lens-not-ground"></a>
- **Covert self-totalization conceded: the ontology a lens, the maximand a floor** (carried-in-part, scope). [theories/memories-and-working-style/synthesis-all.md](../../../../memories-and-working-style/synthesis-all.md), §8, Raised in the corpus, 'Covert self-totalization'; §1 claim 74.
  - Its own sense: A red team charged that expansion of possibility space worked as a covert maximand and a process ontology was crowned as the ground while preaching plurality, the real selectors hidden under neutral openness. Partly conceded: maximand became floor, ontology a lens, one is-ought step marked. A residue is admitted. 「anti-totalization is a deliberate *minimal* totalization」
  - Reading [AI reading]: Two concessions have forms. Not a maximand: widening is a criterion on which, on a finite listing, every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero agrees, not a quantity to maximize. Not the ground: one unfolding is an argued thesis, nonduality a method requirement proving no ontology; yet the thesis does say there is one unfolding, more than a lens. Hidden selectors: 'for life' says whose way it is, not whose losses count, and a ranking names its scope and order. The one exclusion, the will to finalize, was near T8's former refuter, a pure closing; revised T8 (9 November 2026) no longer has that refuter.
  - Read against [COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION.md#1-a-direction-as-a-criterion](../../../COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION.md#1-a-direction-as-a-criterion): So the direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed.
  - Read against [08-METHOD.md#one-relational-unfolding](../../../chapters/08-METHOD.md#one-relational-unfolding) (the thesis's statement): Thesis (philosophical, argued). There is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved; neither result shows that reality has none.
  - Read against [08-METHOD.md#beginning-within-the-one-unfolding](../../../chapters/08-METHOD.md#beginning-within-the-one-unfolding): A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything. Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.
  - Read against [07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses](../../../chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#theses) (T8): T8, argued: for life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation need not count those who depend on one: seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step we offer, the step of invariance. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on, so it could pass through their prudence alone; it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them.
  - The account adds: Where the criterion says nothing: mixed comparisons, decided both ways by positive weightings.
  - The source adds: The charge of self-totalization by name and its admitted residue. The account does not ask whether its own unification is one. A floor is not stated as such: C asks a ranking and sets no minimum, and the nearest, priority of basic conditions (J1, J2), is a further named premise.
<a id="cx-memories-value-words-recast"></a>
- **Value words recast in systems language, so values arrive as consequences** (changed, divergence). [theories/memories-and-working-style/synthesis-all.md](../../../../memories-and-working-style/synthesis-all.md), §1 claim 87.
  - Its own sense: Value words such as freedom and dignity have no solid ground, so they are recast as degrees of freedom, exit, voice and undo, requisite variety, correction loops, substrate and renewal. With one owned premise, plurality, care and non-foreclosure then arrive as consequences rather than tastes. 「have no solid ground」
  - Reading [AI reading]: The account recasts likewise: what a course admits, and widening, defined with no premise. It denies the transfer: ranking the wider above is an order's: where the condition holds de se, self-concern's, which ranks every widening above on a finite listing; elsewhere one a result names; whose losses count is the continuation condition's scope, narrower scopes counting particular ones; and the definition carries no 'better'. On witnesses a widening stands below what it widens by a net weighting or a game's payoffs. So recasting gains exactness and no ought, and 'consequences, not tastes' is what the account withholds.
  - Read against [ONE-PAGE.md](../../../ONE-PAGE.md): “one course *widens* another where at every step it admits all the other admits and at some step more”; where relations close, read across all steps, so that every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, “Call a life's order over courses *self-concerned* when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach: there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens”, widening being “more future”. That a life forms such an order is “not shown: in the proofs it is a hypothesis”; mutual dependence and that ranking “compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite”.
  - Read against [08-METHOD.md#philosophical-warrant](../../../chapters/08-METHOD.md#philosophical-warrant): 'C's no-loss extension is widening by definition, so the definition carries no "better": widening is more future, not a good set over less, and on a finite listing exactly what every additive weighting that counts each listed item above zero ranks higher'; 'where the condition held de se holds and admission is decided, self-concern ranks so every extension between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, so that their admissions end'.
  - Read against [08-METHOD.md#open-programme](../../../chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-programme): Calling an input immanent, or moving it into a definition, does not discharge it.
  - Where the account stops: [07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-what-would-give-c](../../../chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-what-would-give-c); [what-would-give-c](../../records/what-would-give-c.md) recorded-checked (theorem): It is not itself a route to C: it says what 'weaker' can mean and where each route to an order meeting C rests. Witnesses: where admission is imposed, an item a net weighting counts below zero can put a widening below what it widens; among choosers, widening the one menu both choose from can lower what each gets by the game's payoffs, at the only mutual best response of one play.
  - The account adds: Where the recast term stops carrying value: premises listed apart, each named where used.
  - The source adds: That value words have no ground, and that values follow from dynamics with one premise.
